name: Nascent Barrier Glimpses 3 at level 3+
notes: Nascent Barrier's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. The champion's Counters are patched with 3 level counters so the Level 3+ Glimpse 3 clause is reachable; the [Class Bonus] damage-prevention clause (CLERIC class) is out of scope since the default champion is SPIRIT class. Without a discount, the full 2-reserve cost is paid, then both players decline the EffectStackActiveResponse opportunity window before the Glimpse 3 MZREARRANGE decision appears, answered by keeping all 3 revealed cards on top in the same order.
